fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Mechanized tracked platoons ride armored personnel carriers that provide all-terrain mobility and meaningful protection against small arms and shrapnel. The tracked transport allows these platoons to keep pace with armor formations across broken ground where wheeled vehicles would bog down. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
